discord.title: Discord announcements
discord.intro: The portal posts to a channel on your server every time something happens in the league. No bot to install: just a channel webhook.

status.invalid: That doesn't look like a Discord webhook URL.
status.newUrl: New URL. Save to switch channels.
status.clearing: Empty field: saving stops posts to this channel.
status.saved: Saved. Upcoming posts go to this channel.
status.test: Test message sent. Check the channel.

preview.title: Channel preview
preview.lang: Posts go out in Portuguese for now.

howto.title: How to get the webhook
howto.step1: In Discord, open the channel settings.
howto.step3: Copy the URL and paste it here.
howto.privacy: The URL is stored only on the portal's server and is never shown to other members.
